# Slider

Figma: [03h. Slider](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-903) · Family: 03 Form & Input · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-05-25

A continuous-value selector - the user drags a thumb along a track to pick a numeric value within a min-max range. Common uses on Safqah: investment amount selection within a deal range, risk tolerance setting, percentage allocation, deal duration filter. Pair the bare Slider with form chrome via Slider Field for primary form contexts.

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/slider/reference.png`

### Slider Field

A Slider wrapped with a label and helper for picking an approximate value within a range, with error messaging.

Level: organism · Contains: Input Label, Slider, Input Helper Text

Use when:
- Choosing an approximate investment amount within a deal range in a calculator
- Risk tolerance or allocation percentage in onboarding
- Showing a value locked by tier rules: State=disabled

Don't use when:
- The exact amount matters (investing, withdrawing): use Input Amount
- Two-ended ranges (min and max): use two linked Sliders or Date Range Field for dates; there is no range slider
- Small integer counts: use NumericStepper

Accessibility: Support arrow keys and announce the current value with units (for example 5,000 ر.س); md and sm thumbs need a larger touch region.

> Not published to the Figma library. Use it by name everywhere; in another Figma file take its published route or copy it from the Syntropy file (syntropy-components, unpublished.md).

### Slider

The bare slider control (track, fill, thumb, optional value tooltip) for layouts that provide their own label.

Level: molecule · Part of: Slider Field, Form Field

Use when:
- Inside Slider Field or a Form Field slot
- Custom calculator layouts where the value is shown elsewhere

Don't use when:
- A primary form field that needs a label and error: use Slider Field
- Precise amounts: use Input Amount
- Showing progress (not input): use ProgressBar

Accessibility: Needs an external accessible name and value text when used alone.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

Slider lets users pick a numeric value along a continuous range by dragging a thumb. The filled portion of the track visualizes how far along the range the current value sits. Used on Safqah for: investment slot quantity selection in a deal cart, risk tolerance configuration, percentage allocation between asset classes, deal duration filters.

Two components: the bare Slider (just track + thumb, for inline use within complex layouts), and Slider Field (Slider wrapped with Input Label + Helper for primary form contexts). Use Slider for tight contexts where the surrounding UI provides labeling; use Slider Field whenever the slider needs explicit labeling and validation messaging.

### At a glance

### Atomic architecture

Slider follows a simple two-tier pattern: the bare Slider control and a Slider Field wrapper that composes it with Input Label + Helper.

Component - Slider · 30 variants

The bare slider - track + filled portion + thumb + optional value tooltip. Variants: 3 sizes × 5 states × 2 directions. Use directly when surrounding UI provides labeling (e.g., as a child of a form row with its own label, or as part of a custom layout where you want full control over chrome).

Component - Slider Field · 30 variants

Slider wrapped with Input Label + Helper from page 03a - same atomic pattern as Input, Input Phone, Select. Use when the slider needs descriptive labeling, optional helper text, and validation messaging (error state with red track + red helper).

### Sizes

Three sizes match the form family. lg for primary touch contexts (mobile-first), md for standard desktop density, sm for compact layouts.

Large (20dp thumb, 4dp track)

Primary forms - investment amount selection, risk tolerance setup. Thumb easily exceeds WCAG 2.5.5 AAA when combined with vertical drag area. Use on mobile by default.

Medium (16dp thumb, 4dp track)

Standard desktop density - settings forms, filter panels. Most common choice for dense desktop UIs where the slider sits among multiple form rows.

Small (14dp thumb, 3dp track)

Compact contexts - inline editors, table-cell controls. Avoid on touch-only contexts; thumb is below WCAG 2.5.5 AA minimum.

### States

Five states cover the slider lifecycle. Error state uses a red track fill (bg/error) for inline validation; disabled drops the entire slider to 50% opacity.

default

Resting state. Track fill at bg/brand/primary (green) showing current value position. Thumb has white fill, green 2dp border, subtle drop shadow.

hover

Cursor/touch hover. Same colors as default - Slider relies on the cursor change rather than a color shift for hover feedback (Material 3 convention).

focus

Keyboard focus or pre-drag. 2dp dark focus ring (border/focus) outside the thumb circle. Visible across all surrounding states.

error

Invalid value (out of range, etc.). Track fill switches to bg/error (red), thumb border matches. Pair with Slider Field for the red helper message below.

disabled

Inert. Entire slider drops to 50% opacity. Track fill still shows the value position so users can see what was set, even when they can't change it.

### Direction - LTR and RTL

Slider flips its fill direction for Arabic context. In LTR, the filled portion extends from the left (low end) to the thumb. In RTL, fill extends from the right (which IS the low end in Arabic - right = start of reading order) to the thumb. This matches the universal "value increases from start to end" convention, where start respects reading direction.

LTR

Default. Min value (0) on the left, max on the right. Fill extends from left edge to thumb. Standard for English contexts.

RTL

Arabic context. Min value on the right (Arabic reading start), max on the left. Fill extends from right edge to thumb. The thumb visually moves leftward as value increases - matches Arabic number line conventions.

> **Tip:** Important: in RTL, the on-screen LEFT edge represents the MAX value, not min. Numbers below the slider (if shown) should run from min on the right to max on the left, matching the visual fill direction.

### Value tooltip

Optional value tooltip appears above the thumb when Show Tooltip is enabled. Use it during active drag/focus to show the precise value, especially when the slider sits beside other context-dependent UI (no separate value display).

Show Tooltip = true

Tooltip visible above thumb. Default text is "60" - override via the Value text property. Useful during drag interactions, or as a permanent display when the value isn't shown elsewhere.

Show Tooltip = false (default)

Tooltip hidden. Use when the surrounding UI shows the value separately (e.g., next to the slider label, or in a derived display).

> **Info:** For runtime use: framework code should toggle Show Tooltip true on focus/drag start, and back to false on blur/drag end. The static variants show both states for reference; the actual show/hide is animation-driven at runtime.

### Code examples

How to consume Slider in Flutter.

### Flutter - basic Slider

```dart
// Investment amount slider within deal range
SafqahSlider(
  value: _investmentAmount,
  min: deal.minInvestment,
  max: deal.maxInvestment,
  divisions: 100,
  onChanged: (value) {
    setState(() => _investmentAmount = value);
  },
  onChangeEnd: (value) {
    // Persist on drag end, not every step
    _saveInvestmentAmount(value);
  },
)
```

### Flutter - Slider Field with label and helper

```dart
// Slider with full form chrome
SafqahSliderField(
  label: 'Investment amount',
  helperText: 'Enter an amount between ${formatCurrency(min)} and ${formatCurrency(max)}',
  value: _amount,
  min: min,
  max: max,
  divisions: 100,
  showTooltip: true,  // show current value above thumb during drag
  state: _amount < min || _amount > max
    ? SliderState.error
    : SliderState.defaultState,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _amount = v),
)
```

### Flutter - Slider with tooltip and value formatter

```dart
// Slider with formatted tooltip showing SAR amount
SafqahSlider(
  value: _amount,
  min: 1000,
  max: 100000,
  divisions: 99,
  showTooltip: true,
  valueText: NumberFormat.compactCurrency(
    locale: 'en_SA',
    symbol: 'SAR ',
  ).format(_amount),  // "SAR 5K" instead of "5000"
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _amount = v),
)
```

### Flutter - RTL Arabic context

```dart
// Arabic locale - slider flips fill direction
Directionality(
  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
  child: SafqahSliderField(
    label: 'مبلغ الاستثمار',  // "Investment amount"
    helperText: 'المبلغ بين 1,000 و 100,000 ريال',
    value: _amount,
    min: 1000,
    max: 100000,
    showTooltip: true,
    valueText: '${_amount.toStringAsFixed(0)} ريال',
    onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _amount = v),
  ),
)
```

### Usage - Do and Don't

Four concrete Safqah scenarios paired with their wrong counterparts.

- **Do** · Continuous range with imprecise feel: Use Slider when the user picks from a continuous range AND precise values aren't critical - investment amount within a deal range, risk tolerance, percentage allocation. The drag interaction makes adjustment feel natural.
- **Don't** · Continuous range with imprecise feel: Don't use Slider when the exact value matters (e.g., entering an exact loan amount, picking a specific number for transfer). Use Input Amount - typing is faster and more accurate for precise numeric entry.
- **Do** · Validation feedback: On invalid value (e.g., below deal minimum), show error state with red track + red helper text. User immediately sees what's wrong without scrolling or hunting through the form.
- **Don't** · Validation feedback: Don't silently clamp to min/max without feedback. Don't show a toast that disappears. The Slider Field already has a helper text slot - use it.

|  | Do |
| --- | --- |
Arabic RTL form

RTL direction. Fill extends from the right (min) to the thumb. Numbers/labels on either side of the slider should match the reading flow - min on right, max on left.

- **Don't** · Arabic RTL form: Don't use LTR direction in Arabic contexts. The fill direction breaks the user's mental model - Arabic readers expect "smaller values closer to the start of reading order (right)".
- **Do** · Locked range (out of user's tier): Disabled state when the slider value is locked by external constraint (e.g., investment amount fixed by tier rules). Show the locked value but make it visually clear the user can't change it.
- **Don't** · Locked range (out of user's tier): Don't leave a locked slider in active state - user drags, value doesn't change, looks broken. Don't hide the locked range entirely either - user needs to see the value to understand the context.

### Notes from the maintainer

Implementation decisions, trade-offs, and things to watch out for.

> **Info:** Slider follows a two-tier pattern: the bare Slider (track + thumb only) and Slider Field (wrapped with Input Label + Helper). Same convention as Input vs Input Field implicit in the rest of the family - bare for inline use, wrapped for primary forms. Cross-page atom reuse: Slider Field reuses Input Label and Input Helper atoms from page 03a.

> **Info:** Track width is fixed at 280px in the variant set, but at runtime the Slider stretches to fill its container width. The 280px is the layout default for visualization purposes only - Flutter SafqahSlider expands horizontally inside its parent.

> **Info:** Fill percentage hardcoded at 60% in all variants for visualization. At runtime, the fill width is computed from (value - min) / (max - min). The 60% is just a visual default; not a default value at the framework level.

> **Info:** Focus ring is a separate Frame node positioned outside the thumb, NOT a stroke on the thumb itself. This is because the thumb has its own colored stroke (green/red border) that takes precedence - adding a focus stroke would require swapping or stacking strokes, which Figma doesn't support cleanly. A separate ring frame is the cleanest approach.

> **Info:** Tooltip uses bg/inverse and text/onInverse for dark-on-white contrast. If the surrounding context already has a dark background, the tooltip will read as low-contrast - flag for future polish if you need a tooltip variant for dark surfaces.

> **Warning:** Thumb drop shadow is inline DROP_SHADOW (color 12% black, y=1, blur=3), NOT bound to a shadow effect style. If the elevation system gets proper shadow styles later, rebind. Same flag as Dropdown Menu shadow on the Select page.

> **Warning:** Stroke widths are raw px (2dp on thumb border, 2dp on focus ring) - no stroke-width primitive in DS. Same flag carried across all form components.

> **Warning:** WCAG WARNING - md and sm thumb sizes are below WCAG 2.5.5 AA minimum (24dp) for the thumb circle alone. Touch contexts need expanded touch target padding around the thumb (Flutter's default Slider widget handles this; if you build a custom version, ensure the GestureDetector wraps a 24dp+ region).

> **Warning:** Range Slider (two-thumb) not built in this iteration - flagged for follow-up. For now, range selection patterns (deal duration filter, amount range filter) need two separate single-thumb Sliders with their values linked at the app level, OR a custom widget. Range Slider would share the track and add a second thumb on the same horizontal axis.

> **Warning:** FONT WORKAROUND - Same as the rest of the form family. Tooltip text uses IBM Plex Sans Medium. Font/Size, Font/Line-Height, and Font/Weight all bound to variables on every text node.
